title: Billing of Dental and Vision Savings Membership Fees
content:
# Billing of Membership Fees

## Article 1 — Fees by billing frequency

Under the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships, annual billing charges the annual membership fee per term, with no activation fee when the activation fee is waived on annual billing. Monthly billing charges the monthly membership fee each month plus the activation fee once.

For each of the six memberships the annual charge is that membership's annual membership fee and the monthly charge is its monthly membership fee, as listed in the membership fee schedule:

| Membership | Annual billing charges | Monthly billing charges |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Smile Savings Individual | Its annual membership fee | Its monthly membership fee |
| Cascade Smile Savings Household | Its annual membership fee | Its monthly membership fee |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual | Its annual membership fee | Its monthly membership fee |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Household | Its annual membership fee | Its monthly membership fee |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual | Its annual membership fee | Its monthly membership fee |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Household | Its annual membership fee | Its monthly membership fee |

## Article 2 — Price protection, renewal and changes of membership

The fee is fixed for the current term, and a new fee applies only from a renewal after the membership's set number of calendar days of price-change notice. Memberships renew automatically, and annual members receive a renewal notice the membership's set number of renewal-notice days before the renewal date. A change to another membership takes effect at the next renewal.

## Article 3 — Fee entries and the membership fee balance

The purchase charges the first membership fee on the enrollment date, for the period that begins on the activation date; each renewal charges the membership fee for the new term. The membership fee balance is the membership and activation fees owed by the member, and is negative when the member holds a credit; it is 0.00 before the first fee is charged. A fee charged raises the balance; a payment received and a fee credited lower it; a refund paying a credit balance back to the member raises it again.

## Hypothetical illustration

A membership with a hypothetical monthly fee of 12.00 and a hypothetical activation fee of 15.00 is charged 27.00 for its first month (the monthly fee together with the activation fee) and 12.00 for each later month. On annual billing with the activation fee waived, only the annual fee is charged for the term.
